Gauntlet
  • A is the easier one to read. It's clear what to tap and where it goes, but it puts two more round buttons near the Play button.
  • D keeps the bottom band empty and makes the title feel like one page in a row. The names stand on end, and half a medal is a smaller target.
  • Either way: when locked, both show the doors greyed with a padlock. They could stay hidden until they open instead.
